identity_source: Run identity comes from the frozen workflow run lists at the acquisition commit and is validated against run.json and the endpoint record (arm, case, seed, mode, commit, requested/simulated, threads, energy, binary hash, slab depths, record hashes). A case-F record.json is read only through the record binding of the acquisition commit, which names the schema its writer emitted and the study it wrote (pe1 at 2f9dab40); a record of another schema, or mixing two, refuses; a record whose study is not the bound one is an unusable run.
